name: Compound V3
description: Compound is an algorithmic, autonomous interest rate protocol built for developers, to unlock a universe of open financial applications.

methodology.Fees: Total borrow interest paid by borrowers across Compound V3 markets.
methodology.Revenue: Spread between borrow interest paid by borrowers and supply interest distributed to lenders. Accumulates as protocol reserves on each Comet contract, withdrawable to the Compound DAO Treasury via Governance.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Spread between borrow interest paid by borrowers and supply interest distributed to lenders. Accumulates as protocol reserves on each Comet contract, withdrawable to the Compound DAO Treasury via Governance.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Supply interest distributed to lenders (supplyRate × totalSupply).

Fees.Borrow Interest: Interest paid by borrowers across all Comet markets, computed as getBorrowRate(utilization) × totalBorrow.

Revenue.Borrow Interest: Per-market reserve accumulation (borrow interest − supply interest), excluding markets that are in temporary deficit.

ProtocolRevenue.Borrow Interest: Per-market reserve accumulation (borrow interest − supply interest), excluding markets that are in temporary deficit.

SupplySideRevenue.Borrow Interest: Supply interest paid to lenders, computed as getSupplyRate(utilization) × totalSupply.
